run_penalty_comparison_plot: run the module to generate and save a PDF plot comparing invariance penalties across t values
create_sample_data: create synthetic training samples with configurable noise level and sample size using the sample function
compute_ls_penalty: compute the least squares invariance penalty between two datasets with a configurable transformation weight
compute_gradient_penalty: compute the gradient-based invariance penalty between two datasets using closed-form gradient norms
fit_ridge_regression: fit a Ridge regression model to input features and targets and return the learned coefficients
